import type { Guide, GuideSection } from './guide-docs'
import { documentedTokens } from './documented-tokens'

export const nativeFormTopics=['field','form-control','checkbox','radio','switch'] as const
export type NativeFormTopic=typeof nativeFormTopics[number]
const wrap=(markup:string)=>`<div data-native-forms-demo>${markup}</div>`
const html=(source:string)=>({example:wrap(source),code:[{language:'html',source:wrap(source)}]})
const stack=(...items:string[])=>`<div class="vstack gap-3">${items.join('')}</div>`
const text=(id:string,label:string,attrs='type="text"',classes='form-control',help='')=>`<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="${id}">${label}</label><input class="${classes}" id="${id}" ${attrs}${help?` aria-describedby="${id}-help"`:''}>${help?`<small class="form-text" id="${id}-help">${help}</small>`:''}</div>`
const select=(id:string,label:string,attrs='',classes='form-control')=>`<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="${id}">${label}</label><select class="${classes}" id="${id}" ${attrs}><option value="design">Design</option><option value="engineering">Engineering</option><option value="support">Support</option></select></div>`
const textarea=(id:string,label:string,attrs='',classes='form-control')=>`<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="${id}">${label}</label><textarea class="${classes}" id="${id}" rows="3" ${attrs}></textarea></div>`
const choice=(kind:'checkbox'|'radio'|'switch',id:string,label:string,attrs='',modifier='',help='')=>{
  const input=`<input type="${kind==='radio'?'radio':'checkbox'}" id="${id}" ${kind==='switch'?'role="switch" switch':''} ${kind==='switch'?'':`class="${kind==='radio'?'radio':'check'} ${modifier}"`} ${attrs}${help?` aria-describedby="${id}-help"`:''}>`
  return `<div class="form-field">${kind==='switch'?`<span class="switch ${modifier}">${input}</span>`:input}${help?`<div class="form-field-content"><label for="${id}">${label}</label><small class="form-text" id="${id}-help">${help}</small></div>`:`<label for="${id}">${label}</label>`}</div>`
}
const radioGroup=(id:string,legend:string,first:string,second:string)=>`<fieldset class="form-group"><legend>${legend}</legend>${choice('radio',id+'-first',first,`name="${id}" value="first" checked`)}${choice('radio',id+'-second',second,`name="${id}" value="second"`)}</fieldset>`
const dark=(markup:string)=>`<div data-trm-theme="dark" dir="rtl" class="bg-body fg-body rounded-5 p-3">${markup}</div>`
const themes=(kind:'checkbox'|'radio'|'switch')=>stack(...['primary','success','inverse'].map(color=>choice(kind,`native-${kind}-theme-${color}`,color+' specimen',`checked name="${kind}-${color}" value="yes"`,'theme-'+color)))
const sizes=(kind:'checkbox'|'radio'|'switch')=>stack(...['sm','','lg'].map(size=>choice(kind,`native-${kind}-size-${size||'default'}`,(size||'Default')+' '+kind,`checked name="${kind}-size-${size||'default'}" value="yes"`,size?`${kind==='checkbox'?'check':kind}-${size}`:'')))
const disabled=(kind:'checkbox'|'radio'|'switch')=>stack(choice(kind,`native-${kind}-disabled`,'Unavailable '+kind,'disabled'),choice(kind,`native-${kind}-disabled-checked`,'Unavailable checked '+kind,'disabled checked'))

export const nativeFormDemoCss=`[data-native-forms-demo] { --trm-danger-fg: var(--trm-danger-fg-emphasis); --trm-success-fg: var(--trm-success-fg-emphasis); }
[data-native-forms-demo] .form-control { --trm-control-placeholder-color: var(--trm-fg-2); }
[data-native-forms-demo] .form-ghost::placeholder { color: var(--trm-fg-2); opacity: 1; }
[data-native-forms-demo] .form-control-plaintext:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
:is([dir="rtl"] [data-native-forms-demo], [data-native-forms-demo][dir="rtl"]) :is(select.form-control, .form-control-caret) { --trm-control-select-bg-position: left .75rem center; }`
export const indeterminateDemoJavascript=`document.querySelectorAll('[data-native-indeterminate]').forEach(input => {
  input.indeterminate = true
})`

// Source-derived defaults missing from the older generic documentation catalog.
// These are prose/table data, not a second implementation or a generator change.
const radioDefaults=[['size','1.25rem'],['margin-block','.125rem'],['bg','var(--trm-bg-body)'],['border-color','var(--trm-border-color)'],['checked-bg','var(--trm-control-checked-bg)'],['checked-border-color','var(--trm-control-checked-border-color)'],['disabled-bg','var(--trm-control-disabled-bg)'],['disabled-opacity','var(--trm-control-disabled-opacity)']]
const switchDefaults=[['height','1.25rem'],['width','calc(var(--trm-switch-height) * 1.75)'],['padding','.0625rem'],['margin-block','.125rem'],['transition-duration','var(--trm-control-transition-duration)'],['transition-timing','var(--trm-control-transition-timing)'],['bg','var(--trm-bg-3)'],['border-width','var(--trm-border-width)'],['border-color','var(--trm-border-color)'],['indicator-bg','var(--trm-white)'],['indicator-width','calc(var(--trm-switch-height) - calc(var(--trm-switch-padding) * 2) - var(--trm-switch-border-width) * 2)'],['indicator-height','calc(var(--trm-switch-height) - calc(var(--trm-switch-padding) * 2) - var(--trm-switch-border-width) * 2)'],['checked-bg','var(--trm-control-checked-bg)'],['checked-border-color','var(--trm-switch-checked-bg)'],['checked-indicator-bg','var(--trm-white)'],['disabled-bg','var(--trm-control-disabled-bg)'],['disabled-indicator-bg','var(--trm-fg-3)']]
export const nativeFormTokens={
  field:[],
  'form-control':documentedTokens('forms').filter(t=>['form-control-tokens','form-text-tokens'].some(map=>t.purpose.includes('$'+map+';'))),
  checkbox:documentedTokens('forms').filter(t=>t.name.startsWith('--trm-check-')),
  radio:radioDefaults.map(([name,value])=>({name:'--trm-radio-'+name,defaultValue:value!,purpose:'Declared in $radio-tokens; configure before first Sass load.'})),
  switch:switchDefaults.map(([name,value])=>({name:'--trm-switch-'+name,defaultValue:value!,purpose:'Declared in $switch-tokens; configure before first Sass load.'}))
}
const tokens=(topic:NativeFormTopic):GuideSection=>({heading:'CSS variables',paragraphs:['These are source-derived property defaults, not a JavaScript options API. Embedded SVG strings are summarized in the table; inspect the pinned Sass for the exact mask/caret data. Null-valued Sass entries are not emitted as CSS declarations.'],table:{headings:['Property','Default'],rows:nativeFormTokens[topic].map(t=>[t.name,t.name.includes('icon-')||/select-bg(?:-dark)?$/.test(t.name)?'Embedded SVG data URL (see Sass source)':t.defaultValue]),keyboardScroll:true}})
export const nativeFormSass:Record<NativeFormTopic,string>={
  field:"@use 'tremplin/scss/root' with ($root-tokens: (--trm-radius-7: .75rem));\n@use 'tremplin/scss/forms/form-field';",
  'form-control':`@use 'tremplin/scss/root' with (\n  $root-tokens: (\n    --trm-btn-input-compact-min-height: 2.125rem,\n    --trm-btn-input-compact-padding-y: .25rem,\n    --trm-btn-input-compact-padding-x: .625rem,\n    --trm-btn-input-compact-font-size: 1rem,\n    --trm-btn-input-compact-line-height: 1.5,\n    --trm-btn-input-compact-border-radius: .5rem\n  )\n);\n@use 'tremplin/scss/forms/form-control' with (\n  $form-control-tokens: (--trm-control-border-radius: .5rem, --trm-control-box-shadow: none),\n  $form-control-sizes: (compact: true)\n);`,
  checkbox:"@use 'tremplin/scss/forms/check' with ($check-tokens: (--trm-check-size: 1.375rem));",
  radio:"@use 'tremplin/scss/forms/radio' with ($radio-tokens: (--trm-radio-size: 1.375rem));",
  switch:"@use 'tremplin/scss/forms/switch' with ($switch-tokens: (--trm-switch-height: 1.375rem));"
}
const setup:GuideSection={heading:'Explicit demo accessibility CSS',paragraphs:['Copy this scoped application CSS with the example wrappers. It emphasizes feedback/placeholder text, restores a visible plaintext focus outline, and mirrors the otherwise physical select/caret background position for RTL. These are disclosed demo choices; the pinned core defaults remain unchanged.'],code:[{language:'css',source:nativeFormDemoCss}]}
const css=(topic:NativeFormTopic,paragraphs:string[]=[]):GuideSection=>({heading:'Sass customization',paragraphs,code:[{language:'scss',source:nativeFormSass[topic]}]})
const guide=(slug:NativeFormTopic,title:string,description:string,lead:string,sections:GuideSection[],clientScript?:string):Guide=>({slug:'forms/'+slug,group:'Forms',title,description,lead,reference:{title:'Tremplin source',url:'https://github.com/DevCiel/tremplin/blob/main/site/src/data/native-form-guides.ts'},sections:[...sections,setup],clientScript})
